title: 第13章 大壮~你快要把姐的魂儿勾走了
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
周香兰扭着性感的身子，走上前抓着李大壮的手就往屋里拽。

    周香兰的手虽然不如许红妆的那么纤细，但也柔软白嫩，一点都不像农村女人的手。

    她的背影更是婀娜多姿，波浪长发散在秀美的后背，散发出阵阵洗发水的花香味，水蛇腰扭来扭去，带动的翘臀也跟着扭动，碎花连衣裙垂到大腿处，露出半截白嫩嫩的美腿。

    一举一动间，全是少妇芬芳曼妙，李大壮真是想不通，这么漂亮的女人，她男人是咋舍得跟她离婚的？

    正想入非非呢，周香兰忽然停了下来，李大壮没刹住车，一下撞在了周香兰秀美性感的后背上，由于身高差，大腿还正好贴在周香兰的后翘上，这一下可给周香兰刺激坏了。

    李大壮宽阔的胸膛，精壮有力的大腿，都带着火热的温度，紧贴在她身上，惹得她碎花裙内的皮肉滚烫，尤其是那两座后翘，已经忍不住颤抖起来……

    李大壮感受着周香兰的曼妙，更是“火冒三丈”，那圆滚滚的后翘，咋就这么有弹性呢？

    “嗯~大壮，你个傻小子还挺有劲儿，差点没给人家撞飞~”周香兰娇软的嗔怪，声音也和后翘一样打着颤儿……

    “不好意思，香兰姐，我不小心的。”李大壮挠了挠头，有些依依不舍的后退。

    谁料周香兰竟反手按住李大壮的腰，将他紧按在自己身后，娇喘着说：“好大壮，别走，再跟姐贴一会儿~~姐这样，舒服~~”

    周香兰真是寂寞狠了，甚至都忘了李大壮可能已经不傻了的事儿，只顾着享受这一刻的放松……

    李大壮这下再也压不住了……

    周香兰自然能感受到他的变化，顿时张大了嘴巴，仿佛能塞得下两颗大鸡蛋！

    “大壮，你，你小子也太………”周香兰娇喘吁吁，空虚许久的身子，生出难言的渴望，恨不能化在李大壮怀里……

    “也不知道谁能有福气嫁给你，别说嫁了，就算是只能给你当相好，这辈子也值了啊！”

    “咳咳，香兰姐，别闹了，我一个傻子，给我当相好啥好值的。”李大壮嘴上这么说，身体却越来越不舍得撤离了。

    周香兰竟还不知轻重的晃了下身子，惹得李大壮热火冲天，重重的喘了口粗气！

    周香兰心中难耐，语气更是娇软勾人，仿佛浸泡了蜜水一般：“大壮~你快要把姐的魂儿勾走了。”

Li Dazhuang imagined that scene in his mind, and his nosebleed almost came out!

"Dazhuang, sister-in-law, look, this is the test result of the aphrodisiac, it's so awesome!"

Cheng Lusi had no idea what her sister-in-law and Li Dazhuang were thinking, so she excitedly handed the report in her hand to Li Dazhuang.

"Ahem!" Li Dazhuang cleared his throat, trying to cover up the surging Qi and blood in his body: "I made the medicine. I know the effect. Let Mr. Jiang take a look."

Jiang Shuying was a little unhappy when she heard that Li Dazhuang called her Mr. Jiang again. She took the report with one hand and squeezed the side of Li Dazhuang's leg hard with the other hand.

Li Dazhuang didn't feel any pain, he just felt distraught!

"Dazhuang, please don't call me sister-in-law, Mr. Jiang. It's too foreign. Just call me sister-in-law like me!" Cheng Lusi smiled and looked at Jiang Shuying again: "Sister-in-law, do you think it's okay?"

"Uh, okay!" Jiang Shuying felt guilty again and did not dare to touch Li Dazhuang. She just lowered her head and read the report seriously.

It didn't matter at this glance, she soon opened her mouth in shock, as if a big radish could be stuffed into her sexy red lips!

"Oh my god! This data shows that impotence patients who take aphrodisiacs can improve their combat effectiveness by an average of twenty minutes! Men with normal health can achieve half an hour! And after our laboratory analyzed the ingredients of the aphrodisiacs, we determined that there are no hormone products, and they are all pure Chinese medicine!"

"There is only the relatively rare dragon root grass, which is quite rare. Although I don't know why this formula has such a good effect, it can be proved that not only does this medicine have no side effects, but it can also nourish the kidneys, replenish qi, and strengthen the body after long-term use!"

The more Jiang Shuying talked, the more excited she became. As an excellent businessman with marriage experience, she knew very well the commercial value of such an aphrodisiac!

Don't underestimate the fighting power of those twenty minutes. For those impotent men, this is a level that they will never reach in their lifetime!

But now you only need to take a Chinese medicine pill that nourishes the body, and you can gain virility and become a real man!

Even men who don’t have kidney deficiency definitely want to improve their fighting time and keep fit at the same time!

As soon as this aphrodisiac drug comes on the market, its appeal to the vast number of men will definitely be fatal!

"Sister-in-law, do I have good taste? Is Da Zhuang a treasure?" Cheng Lusi held Li Dazhuang's arm with some pride. Although she was speaking to Jiang Shuying, her sparkling eyes were not willing to move away from Li Dazhuang for a moment!

She really likes this man so much. With his rough appearance and powerful abilities, I wonder which woman can resist it~

"Okay, great! Dazhuang is indeed a treasure!" Jiang Shuying nodded in approval, her admiration for Li Dazhuang almost overflowing from her beautiful eyes!

"By the way, Dazhuang, here comes your new beauty cream. Take it out and let us try it!" Jiang Shuying was so excited that she forgot to avoid suspicion. She hugged Li Dazhuang's thick arm with her beautiful hands and pressed her chest against it.

Li Dazhuang was squeezed between two women, and he didn't dare to take the pillow off his legs!

Holding back his anger, Li Dazhuang thought, and a can filled with light yellow paste appeared in his hand!
